header.act: ACT II — THE ROAD TO THE TISZA
player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: András Fekete
line.reaction-briliant.text: The rear guard held longer than the enemy's timetable allowed for. That is the first hour this army has won back since the intervention began.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: András Fekete
line.reaction-tactical.text: The line broke before the transport was clear. We saved the army, but not its equipment, and not its confidence.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: András Fekete
line.reaction-victory.text: The withdrawal was carried out in order. The formations are intact, which is more than the staff expected to be able to report.
line.callback-railway-rearguard.speaker: András Fekete
line.callback-railway-rearguard.text: You made the station the heart of the defence. More guns and wounded men reached this line because infantry held beside the tracks. Böhm called the position slow; the railway crews call those hours the reason they are still crews instead of prisoners.
line.callback-mobile-rearguard.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.callback-mobile-rearguard.text: I asked for a mobile rear guard and you trusted my timing. The formations escaped; Fekete lost wagons he cannot replace. I will not call the choice clean simply because it was mine.
line.nyiregyhaza-platform.speaker: András Fekete
line.nyiregyhaza-platform.text: Nyíregyháza station is stacked with ammunition that no locomotive can take. Staff cars arrive from three roads carrying three different maps; wounded men climb onto westbound wagons before the brakes are set. Two columns of smoke on the horizon mark the Romanian pincers.
line.stromfeld-arrives.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-arrives.text: This is no longer one retreat. Units are falling back by separate roads, stores are being abandoned, and commanders report to whichever headquarters still answers the telephone. We cannot defend every town. If Tokaj remains open, we can still turn this flight into a force behind the Tisza.
line.bohm-question.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-question.text: The men have marched for days, and every abandoned wagon becomes a rumour of betrayal. We need one order that every battalion can understand. Do you strike a pincer hard enough to reopen the road, or withdraw by prepared lines with the transport moving first?
Strike one pincer hard enough to reopen the road, then disengage before the second can arrive.
Gain a prestige award and experience for every core formation, but forgo full resupply and the additional transport column.
line.bohm-question.choice.phased-retreat: Build successive rear-guard lines and move the transport first. The army must reach the Tisza intact.
Fully resupply every core formation and gain a transport column, but forgo the counterstroke's prestige and core-wide experience.
line.stromfeld-counterstroke.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-counterstroke.text: Concentrate everything for a short blow. Do not pursue. The purpose is not to win ground but to buy a road and an hour of movement.
line.fekete-retreat.speaker: András Fekete
line.fekete-retreat.text: I will send ammunition and wounded men toward Tokaj first. Once the last train leaves, the bridges and sidings can be denied to the enemy.
line.bohm-final.speaker: Vilmos Böhm
line.bohm-final.text: Get headquarters through Tokaj before the pincers meet. Let the men see guns and wagons moving under orders, not abandoned beside the road. That is the difference between a withdrawal and a flight.
